turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly, no talking. Today we will do subtraction. Write fifty two minus twenty seven in your notebook.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote thirty five? No, no. Wrong. The answer is twenty five. Write twenty five and say it after me: fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, again thirty five? I told you already. Two is smaller, so take a ten. TAKE A TEN. Twelve minus seven is five. Listen properly this time.
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Mina, stop counting on your fingers. Fingers are for small children. Sit down, we will go to the next one.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Now everybody do this one. Sixty three minus twenty eight. Quickly, five minutes only.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: The answer is thirty five. Who got thirty five? Hands up. Okay, those who got it wrong, copy the correct answer from the board.
turns.label: check_whole_class
